use_cases: Primary call-to-action buttons in forms and landing pages
Destructive action buttons with confirmation states
Secondary and ghost-style buttons for less prominent actions
Responsive button components with multiple size variants
ai_summary: A versatile Radix-based button component with CVA-powered variant system supporting default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, and link styles across sm, default, lg, and icon sizes. Built with accessibility-focused ring focus states, composition via Radix Slot, and clean Tailwind utility classes for flexible theming across SaaS, e-commerce, and dev tool interfaces.
